description: This is a Perl test script for user lifecycle functionalities in a web application, including registration, email verification, password reset, login/logout, project creation, and role management.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing helper class for web application user lifecycle testing.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Test::Coocook testing helper.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs a GET request and checks for success.

methods.name: text_contains
methods.description: Checks if the response contains specific text.

methods.name: robots_flags_ok
methods.description: Checks the robots meta tags for indexing permissions.

methods.name: register_fails_like
methods.description: Attempts registration expecting failure matching a regex.

methods.name: register_ok
methods.description: Performs registration expecting success.

methods.name: email_count_is
methods.description: Checks the number of emails sent.

methods.name: email_like
methods.description: Checks if the latest email matches a regex.

methods.name: shift_emails
methods.description: Removes the latest email from the email queue.

methods.name: get_ok_email_link_like
methods.description: Finds an email link matching a regex and performs GET.

methods.name: input_has_value
methods.description: Checks if a form input has a specific value.

methods.name: clear_emails
methods.description: Clears all queued emails.

methods.name: login_fails
methods.description: Attempts login expecting failure.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login expecting success.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link and expects success.

methods.name: submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form expecting success.

methods.name: text_lacks
methods.description: Checks that specific text is not present in the response.

methods.name: change_display_name_ok
methods.description: Changes user display name and expects success.

methods.name: logout_ok
methods.description: Performs logout and expects success.

methods.name: base_is
methods.description: Checks the current URL matches expected.

methods.name: cookie_jar
methods.description: Manages cookies for session persistence.

methods.name: request_recovery_link_ok
methods.description: Requests a password recovery link for an email.
